test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 27 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In statistics out of 100, the marks of 21 students in final exams are as 90, 95, 95, 94, 90, 85, 84, 83, 85, 81, 92, 93, 82, 78, 79, 81, 80, 82, 85, 76, 85, then the mode of data is:
solution:
**Given:**

Total observations = 21

Data = 90, 95, 95, 94, 90, 85, 84, 83, 85, 81, 92, 93, 82, 78, 79, 81, 80, 82, 85, 76, 85

**Formula Used:**

Mode = Value with highest frequency

**Calculation:**

⇒ 76 occurs 1 time

⇒ 78 occurs 1 time

⇒ 79 occurs 1 time

⇒ 80 occurs 1 time

⇒ 81 occurs 2 times

⇒ 82 occurs 2 times

⇒ 83 occurs 1 time

⇒ 84 occurs 1 time

⇒ 85 occurs 4 times

⇒ 90 occurs 2 times

⇒ 92 occurs 1 time

⇒ 93 occurs 1 time

⇒ 94 occurs 1 time

⇒ 95 occurs 2 times

⇒ Highest frequency = 4

⇒ Mode = 85

**∴ The correct answer is 85.**
